# Additive saved lifecycle readback for each of the three actual stage exits.
lifecycle_files=[]
for stage in native['steps']:
 directory=O if stage['name']=='native' else B
 op=directory/(stage['name']+'.owned.json');lp=directory/(stage['name']+'.log')
 e=stage['execution'];assert pin(op)['sha256']==e['process_owner_sha256'] and pin(lp)['sha256']==e['log_sha256']
 own=json.loads(op.read_text());assert own['status']=='HEALTHY' and len(own['processes'])==1
 child=own['processes'][0];assert child['status']=='REAPED_NO_LIVE_MEMBERS' and child['returncode']==0 and not child['members_at_leader_exit']
 lifecycle_files.extend([op,lp])
